notes.title: Release of Demo 2.0!
notes.content:
This demo is single player and will introduce the main concepts of combat in Guardians of Gaia.

 [olist]
[*] [b]Poise system:[/b] Create an opening by breaking down the opponents guard.
[*] [b]Positioning:[/b] Use both high and low attacks to find an opening.
[*] [b]Combat Arts:[/b] Use advanced techniques, unique to each Guardian.
[*] [b]Special Moves:[/b] Parry, guard and attack to charge the EX-meter and unleash devastating attacks.
[*] [b]Weapons:[/b] Experiment with a wide array of weapons,
[*] [b]Elemental system:[/b] Expose your opponents elemental weaknesses.
[*] [b]Stealth:[/b] Use long foliage and aerial advantage to conceal your position.
[/olist]

8 Guardians are featured in the demo across 8 rounds.
Feel up to the challenge?

notes.title: Live Developer Gamplay Stream
notes.content:
Developer goes hands on with Guardians of Gaia introducing core features such as:

- The World
- The Guardians
- The Game-play

Feel free to participate in the live-stream via online battle.
Thanks for watching!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Demo available now!
notes.content:
It's been a long journey, but very excited to announce that the first demo is now available.

Why are you still here. Get to the Steam Store and download it now.
Any feedback is more than welcome over at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1718290/discussions/]Community Hub[/url].
